$description: OnlyJah.com — the platform. Tone: capable, clean, quietly technical. Citrus accent on near-black ink, mono for data/labels, humanist sans for body. This is the file tweakcn/shadcn reads for the base theme; other properties extend it.

citrus.$description: the one accent — CTAs, focus rings, active states. Spend it in one place per screen.

display.$description: headlines, nav, labels, data — the OJ signature: mono where most SaaS uses grotesk

radius.$description: small and consistent — this is an operator's tool, not a toy

shadow.$description: flat by design; hierarchy comes from the border + mono type, not elevation
